messages:
Iris Park: Customer 'delta-co' reporting SSO failures + SCIM dupes after secret rotation. auth logs show aud mismatch and scim shows 409s.

Noah Bennett: paste logs?

Iris Park: auth-proxy:
```
2026-04-02T11:02:03Z ERROR auth-proxy: token verify tenant=delta-co err=invalid_audience expected=client-delta actual=https://idp.delta-co.com
```
scim-provisioner:
```
2026-04-02T11:03:10Z WARN scim: create user failed status=409 externalId='DEL-007 '
2026-04-02T11:03:11Z ERROR scim: webhook verify decrypt: encryption_context_mismatch (ctx=tenant=delta.co vs delta-co)
```

Diego Morales: likely two things: 1) templating substitution replaced SSO_AUDIENCE with IDP_ISSUER during secret-rotate 2) tenant canonicalization changed (dot vs dash) so KMS EncryptionContext differs. The trailing space in externalId explains dupes.

deploy-bot: deploy infra/secret-rotate@2026-04-01T23:50 UTC succeeded (hash: a1b2c)

Noah Bennett: quick mitigation: revert SSO_AUDIENCE fix to validate aud==CLIENT_ID, add tolerant EncryptionContext resolver accepting dash/dot/underscore for KMS Decrypt, and trim externalId on ingest.

Iris Park: I pushed hotfix to auth-proxy to check CLIENT_ID; introspection now returns active:true in staging. Will promote to prod after smoke.

Diego Morales: requeued 9 failed SCIM ops after normalizing externalId: 7 succeeded, 2 still 409 (manual review queued). Also adding a runbook entry for KMS alias rotations: always include canonical tenant mapping and a tolerant map for legacy forms.

security-bot: filed VULN-2026-200 (low) for templating substitution risk impacting SSO_AUDIENCE; assigned to Noah Bennett.

Iris Park: customer confirmed SSO restored and majority of provisioning recovered. Follow-ups: Noah add config-drift alert for SSO_AUDIENCE vs CLIENT_ID, Diego add CI test for tenant canonicalization during secret-rotate, Iris will write short postmortem. Thanks all.
